description: This file defines a custom flag.Value implementation for handling external apply configuration mappings in Kubernetes code generation. It includes functions for parsing, serializing, and managing external type-to-package mappings, with support for CSV input/output.

classes.name: externalApplyConfigurationValue
classes.description: A custom implementation of flag.Value for managing external apply configuration mappings, holding a pointer to a map of types.Name to string.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Parses a slice of strings representing external mappings and updates the externals map, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value from a CSV string, parsing it into individual mappings.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name for the flag, which is 'string'.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Serializes the externals map into a CSV string for display.
